text:
Maya: Quick sync 1 int4 candidate (rwd-v6c-int4) is passing unit evallist but we saw a small drift on complex instruction set. Want to lock a rollout that is tolerant to transient blips but still auto-protect. Ideas?

Jon: Suggest staggered windows + soft fallback. Start shadow 24h, then phased traffic [1%, 5%, 20%] over 12h steps. If metric hits badness, first drop to 1% (soft fallback) for 30m then re-evaluate before full rollback.

Priya: Agree. Define "badness" as a combo signal not just single metric. Propose: primary quality metric = instr_fidelity; secondary = halluc_rate + rerank_consistency on long-doc slice. Use a statistical test (two-sided z-test on proportions for instr_fidelity) and require p < 0.05 with min N=2000 per window.

Sam: Ops: add infra gates for latency. If p99 > 2x baseline or p95 > 1.6x baseline for two consecutive infra windows (10m), trigger immediate hard rollback.

Maya: Combining: quality gate = (instr_fidelity drop >=0.6% AND p<0.05) OR (hallucination increase >=0.5% absolute AND sustained 2 windows). Soft-fallback if only borderline (0.3-0.6% drop).

Jon: Also attach sample-size floor per slice. For long-doc slice require min N=300. If window underflows, mark as "insufficient sample" and extend canary by one more window instead of failing.

Priya: Implementation note: metrics are produced by eval-signal pipeline. We should tag the rollout with eval_snapshot id and snapshot_hash so anybody can repro. Also persist the windowed p-values in trace storage.

Sam: Lease/ownership: variant_lease should include owner and allow renewal by infra only while promote in progress. lease_ttl=45m, renew_limit=3. If lease expires without renewal, auto-pause traffic and notify owner. This avoids two teams racing a canary.

Maya: Good. Console UX: show live traffic tier, current window samples, p-value heatmap, and a manual "hold_to_investigate" toggle. For >10% traffic increases require 2 approvers (owner + product).

Priya: I'll draft a promote_policy blob. Paste below -- keep it machine-friendly so model-config can ingest.

```yaml
promote_policy:
  phases:
    - name: shadow
      traffic: 0.0
      duration: 24h
    - name: staggered
      steps:
        - traffic: 0.01
          duration: 3h
        - traffic: 0.05
          duration: 6h
        - traffic: 0.20
          duration: 12h
  gating:
    quality:
      primary_metric: instr_fidelity
      test: two_sided_z
      alpha: 0.05
      min_samples_per_window: 2000
      soft_threshold:
        drop_pct_lower: 0.3
        drop_pct_upper: 0.6
      hard_threshold:
        drop_pct: 0.6
    secondary_metrics:
      - name: halluc_rate
        absolute_increase: 0.5
        consecutive_windows: 2
      - name: rerank_consistency_longdoc
        absolute_increase: 1.0
        consecutive_windows: 2
    infra:
      p99_ratio_threshold: 2.0
      p95_ratio_threshold: 1.6
      window: 10m
      consecutive: 2
  fallback_policy:
    soft_fallback:
      action: scale_down_to_1pct
      duration: 30m
      recheck: true
    hard_fallback:
      action: route_all_to_baseline
      notify: ["#eng-oncall", "@model-owner"]
  lease:
    ttl: 45m
    renew_limit: 3
  manual_controls:
    require_approvals_for_traffic_pct_over: 10
    approvers_required: 2
  audit:
    persist_pvalues: true
    attach_eval_snapshot: true
    snapshot_field: eval_snapshot_id
```

Jon: Nice. Minor tweak: set min_samples_per_window to 1500 for production low-traffic slices but keep 2000 for core slices. We can allow slice-level overrides.

Sam: I'll wire infra alarms. Also ensure debug traces for requests that contributed to p-value failure are retained in /var/onboard/traces/r-1778890001 for 7 days.

deploy-bot: rollout-automation: planned rollout id=r-20260402-7 (staggered start 2026-04-02T16:00Z). Automation will enforce promote_policy and lease semantics.

Maya: Thanks. I'll open a small PR to model-config + add UI mockups to the console ticket. If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll schedule the shadow run. :rocket:
